decision_rationale: The model is pretrained on 29.8 million ncRNA sequences and generalizes to unseen RNA types, which supports foundation-model-like pretraining. However, the described objective is masked language modeling on an encoder-only architecture, not a genuinely generative model.
evidence_snippet: "29.8 million noncoding RNA sequences from diverse families"; "Masked Language Model (MLM) self-supervised task"; "reconstruct the original sequences through an output projection"; "well-suited for encoder-only architectures"; "generalize to RNA types not present in the pretraining dataset";"? ???
